reason: 'Deduct the boots, claim the credit on the pass.' Canada's federal public transit tax credit was eliminated in 2017 (Wikipedia, 2017 Canadian federal budget), and an employee cannot generally deduct required work boots/clothing (CRA rule, judged on knowledge).

'Quebec ran its own pension and parental insurance plans instead of the Canada Pension Plan and Employment Insurance.' Quebec workers still pay EI premiums, at a reduced rate (canada.ca EI premium rates 2025); only EI parental benefits are replaced by QPIP. Also adds a false claim: 'GST and QST ... had pushed a four-dollar sandwich past five' is wrong, since 5% + 9.975% (Wikipedia, Sales taxes in Canada) brings $4 to about $4.60.
The story states the rule as avoiding four, then endorses giving 'forty-five' (Dax approves and she gives it). Forty-five contains the number four, which the rule says to avoid.

'after the front door had been opened for Elijah ... Sienna stood to lead the grace after the meal' has the order backwards: the door for Elijah is opened after Barech (Wikipedia, Passover Seder). Also, 'learned all six verses' of Chad Gadya is wrong: it has about ten characters/verses, not six (Wikipedia, Chad Gadya).

'the return of the first theme ... Home again, C major' and the recap transition 'stayed exactly, stubbornly, in C.' In K. 545 the recapitulation begins in F major, the subdominant (Wikipedia, Piano Sonata No. 16 (Mozart)), and the recap transition moves from F back to C.

The story says the 6.2% Social Security withholding alone explains the pay 'down to the last digit' ($73.15 to $68.62). US employers also withhold 1.45% Medicare on all wages (Wikipedia, FICA), so net pay would be about $67.55.

The customer's gardening books are charged 13% HST ('the 6.24 appear beneath the 48.00'). Printed books in Ontario are exempt from the provincial part of HST (Wikipedia, Harmonized sales tax), so only 5% GST ($2.40) applies.
'the steam sublimated off the edge of the pot.' Sublimation is solid turning straight to gas; steam rising from boiling water does not sublimate.

'if you took the heat away, it would come back toward red. Mostly ... it's what the principle would say.' Nobody corrects this. Le Chatelier's principle does not predict a partial return: back at the original temperature the equilibrium, and so the colour, returns to where it started. (Also, heating a sealed glass tube directly over a stove is shown as fine.)

'the shamash lit the others, right to left, the way his grandfather had done it.' Hanukkah candles are placed right to left but lit left to right, newest candle first (Chabad.org, How to Light the Chanukah Menorah).

'But the telegram was secret. Nobody outside the State Department read it in 1946.' This is the protagonist's claim and it goes uncorrected. In fact, Navy Secretary Forrestal sent copies of the Long Telegram across Washington, and it was widely read by military and executive leaders (Wikipedia, Long Telegram).

'Her test class compiled on the first try' after calling the constructor with 250.00 while the only 'constructor' was 'public void BankAccount(double)'. With no BankAccount(double) constructor, 'new BankAccount(250.00)' does not compile; it only compiles if no argument is passed. (Also, 'void' has four letters, not 'five letters'.)
The cello's open A string is tuned to 440 Hz and its octave reads 880. The cello's A string is A3 (Wikipedia, Cello), an octave below A440, so it is 220 Hz and its octave is 440 Hz.

'quietly defaulting on two thirds of the debt' is wrong: a 65.6% yield means about a third (34.4%) was lost, not two thirds. ('eleven grams of ambition had condensed into eight' also misstates the 12.5 g theoretical yield.)
